specification.objective: Offer optional user-triggered AI semantic preservation review of a compaction proposal.

requirements.statement: Never call the LLM until user explicitly asks and acknowledges content transfer.
Return a structured, evidence-backed uncertainty report of omissions, distortions, ambiguities and citations.
LLM error/timeout never writes memory or changes proposal; configured model restrictions remain Hermes-owned.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Never call the LLM until user explicitly asks and acknowledges content transfer. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
Return a structured, evidence-backed uncertainty report of omissions, distortions, ambiguities and citations. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
LLM error/timeout never writes memory or changes proposal; configured model restrictions remain Hermes-owned. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

invariants.statement: Do not change Hermes files, private method bindings, pending approval execution or compaction native application semantics; retain Magi 1.7.8.

forbidden_states.statement: Unapproved, stale or invalid edits are silently applied; LLM is invoked without explicit user opt-in outside compaction.

inputs.statement: Existing Hermes memory entries and Magi Desktop/backend plugin contracts.

outputs.statement: Documented, tested and reversible UX behavior; no direct native memory file writes.

failure_semantics.statement: On invalid source/remote failure preserve memory, preview and user draft; show actionable error.
